# Kakushin

> > Kakushin offers 500+ Japanese and Western kitchen knives with comprehensive customization, DIY building tools, and professional services for knife enthusiasts and chefs.

Kakushin is a specialized knife retailer based in the Gatineau/Ottawa region of Canada, offering an extensive catalog of Japanese and Western kitchen knives alongside custom knife building services. The site emphasizes personalization through interactive tools, blade/handle selection, and professional engraving and sharpening services.

## Key Topics

- Custom Knife Builder
- Japanese Knives
- Kitchen Knives
- Wa-Handle
- Blade Selection
- Chef Knives
- Santoku
- Gyuto
- Bunka
- Engraving Services
- Knife Sharpening
- DIY Knife Building
- Aogami Blue #2
- Ginsan Silver #3
- Product Customization

## Custom Knife Building

- [Knife Builder Tool | Craft Your Own Kitchen Knife from Blade to Handle](https://kakushin.ca/pages/custom-kitchen-knife-builder): Interactive custom knife builder tool for blade and handle selection
- [Knife Blanks - Build Your Own Custom Kitchen Knife](https://kakushin.ca/collections/blades-blanks): Product collection page for knife blades and DIY customization
- [Knife Handles - Build Your Own Custom Kitchen Knife](https://kakushin.ca/collections/handles-blanks): Product collection page for custom wa-handles and knife handles
- [Build Your Own Knife | Easy & Fast Customization](https://kakushin.ca/blogs/blogs/customize-upgrade-innovate-easy-kitchen-knife-customization): Article on custom knife building with handles, blades, and engraving

## Knife Collections & Products

- [Kakushin | Japanese Knives, Westerns & Customs](https://kakushin.ca): Homepage showcasing Kakushin's 500+ knife models and custom services

## Customization & Finishing Services

- [Custom Knife Engraving Services | In-Store & Online](https://kakushin.ca/products/engraving-services): Laser engraving service offering text, names, and logo customization
- [Professional Knife Sharpening Services (Japanese & Traditional)](https://kakushin.ca/pages/sharpening-services): Professional sharpening service in Gatineau/Ottawa with mail-in options
